verdict_kora_cartes: This hand-drawn, doodle style is excellent for explaining complex economic or historical concepts in a simple, accessible way. It would be highly effective for Kora & Cartes when breaking down abstract ideas or illustrating cause-and-effect relationships, as the visual simplicity keeps the focus on the narrative.
